registered_workload: Build the complete official MkDocs documentation site through the public build command and compare every generated file after normalizing only the embedded build timestamp.
correctness_requirements: The 719 runnable project tests must pass; four Windows symlink privilege tests and one pytest helper collection are explicitly excluded.
The generated file set and every generated file's semantic content must match the serial build.
Navigation, page order, plugin events, templates, static assets, links, warnings and build failures must preserve the original behavior.
The mkdocs build command and configuration format must keep working.
constraints: Use only the project's existing dependencies or the Python standard library.
Do not change the registered workload adapter or the official documentation input.
Do not disable plugins, remove pages or omit generated files to obtain an apparent speedup.
Only the automatically inserted build timestamp is normalized; all other output differences are correctness failures.
The final claim is based on complete end-to-end site build time.
